title: Help Center
subtitle: Learn how to use Vertex Quant

faq_items.basic_1_a: Quantitative trading uses mathematical models and algorithms to automatically execute trades based on preset rules, eliminating emotional interference and enabling 24/7 trading.
faq_items.basic_2_a: Vertex Quant is a professional quantitative trading platform that helps users trade cryptocurrencies automatically using strategies. We offer strategy templates, backtesting, and real-time monitoring.
faq_items.basic_3_a: No! We provide a visual configuration interface. You just need to set parameters to start strategies. We have built-in classic templates suitable for beginners.
faq_items.strategy_1_a: Grid Trading automates buying low and selling high within a set price range. It profits from market volatility and is suitable for ranging markets.
faq_items.strategy_2_a: Trend Following strategies trade along with the market trend. They buy in uptrends and sell in downtrends, capturing large price movements.
faq_items.strategy_3_a: Yes, once started, the strategy executes trades automatically based on your parameters. You can pause or stop it anytime, or set stop-loss/take-profit for protection.
faq_items.strategy_4_a: Based on market conditions: Grid for ranging markets, Trend Following for trending markets. We recommend backtesting first, then testing with small funds.
faq_items.api_1_a: Go to Settings → API Management → Add API Key → Select Exchange → Enter Key and Secret. Ensure only 'Trade' permission is enabled, and 'Withdraw' is DISABLED.
faq_items.api_2_a: Strongly recommended: ✅ Enable 'Trade', ❌ Disable 'Withdraw'. This ensures your funds remain safe even if keys are leaked.
faq_items.api_3_a: Currently supporting WEEX and TurboFlow protocol. Binance and OKX support is coming soon.
faq_items.security_1_a: Funds always remain in your exchange account. We only execute trades via API and cannot withdraw your funds.
faq_items.security_2_a: API keys are encrypted and stored on our backend servers using bank-grade encryption technology.
faq_items.security_3_a: Each strategy has risk parameters like stop-loss percentage, max position size, etc. Set them according to your risk tolerance.
